_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Ou ap jwe Golf (Jwè kat) - Jwè {player_id}.
Bijou: Gen skò total pi ba nan toun sa a. Si kolòn yo pataje menm valè, yo konpte kòm 0.
Valè kat: A=1, 2-10=valè figi, J/Q=10, K=0

Aksyon (itilize mak egzak): 
- '[draw]' - Tire soti nan dek 
- '[take]' - Pran soti nan pak boule 
- '[swap X Y]' - Chanje kat tire ak pozisyon X (liy) Y (kolòn) 
- '[discard]' - Boule kat tire

board.drew:
Ou te tire: {card}
Kounye a ou dwe [swap X Y] oubyen [discard] li.
board.took:
Ou te pran: {card} soti nan pak boule
Ou dwe [swap X Y] ak li (pa ka boule).

options.final_turns: Toun fini! Chwa ou: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Ou dwe: [swap X Y] (pa ka jete kat nan pil dechaje)

action_desc.swapped: Jwè {pid} te chanje {new} ak {old} nan pozisyon ({row},{col})

message.deck_empty: Deck la vid! Jwèt fini imedyatman.
message.knocked: Jwè {pid} te frape! Chak lòt jwè gen yon vire plis.
message.final_round: Jwè {pid} {reason}! Chak lòt jwè gen yon toun plis.

reason.all_revealed: li te revele tout kat yo?

invalid.wrong_action: Itilize yon sèl aksyon ki gen mak: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], oubyen [peek X Y]
invalid.must_draw_first: Ou dwe premye [draw], [take], [knock], oubyen [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Ou pa ka jete yon kat ki soti nan pil la, ou dwe chanje li.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Ou gen yon kat trase. ou dwe [swap X Y] oswa [discard] li.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: You need a drawn card to swap.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: You need a drawn card to discard.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Pozisyon deyò limit. Itilize liy 1-{max_row}, kolòn 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Ou pa ka frape ak yon kat trase. Konplete vire ou an premye.
invalid.already_knocked: Yon moun te deja frape wonn sa a.
